name: Menu Boards
pitch: A printable weekly menu board for small cafes, built from what is in season and what it costs this week, about $30/month. Sources: the Open Recipes Project's ingredient and price tables; a seasonal produce calendar.
blocker: Send 3 outreach emails (lanes/menu-boards/outreach/emails.md) and ask the Open Recipes Project for written OK on commercial use
next_step: tally replies in outreach/replies.md, then final G3

G0.note: ingredient table (2,140 rows) + weekly price table (310 rows) live, keyless, updated Mondays. About page allows reuse; terms page says non-commercial without defining it, written confirmation flagged.
